de.abas.ceks.jedp

Class EDPFTextMode

  • Object
    • EDPFTextMode
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class EDPFTextMode
extends Object
implements Serializable
    This class carries information on the EDP free text mode. These are the kind of presentation for the free text and, with presentation as text, the maximum text length. Instances of this class must be used to set current free text mode at the server and they are provided when retrieving the current free text mode.

    Note: The EDP free text mode affects reading free texts with queries and reading free texts in editors using EDPEditor.getFieldVal) only.
    It does not affect changing free texts and reading free tests using EDPEditor.setFText.

    Version:
    1
    Author:
    xg
